theoryOfGameLine:{\"lines\":[\"e4 e5 Nf3.theory:
The Exchange Variation gives up the bishop pair for a pawn structure White can use in the endgame.

White's plan is to trade queens and use the kingside pawn majority; Black's is the bishop pair and quick development.
